scope: Twelve complete original groups, prioritized by lifetime volume and buyer breadth; exact-source comparisons only.
method: All twelve first-frame group sheets visually inspected. Four spaced frames of each animation inspected (all distinct frames when fewer than four). Sampling is not exhaustive animation review. Rejections do not rule out other originals.
